Type: Town
First Visited: Session 0

Description

The largest town in the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale} and seat of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric Garlandsson}'s ambitions.
Built around the ruins of an old @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Imperium} fort that Aldric has been restoring as his keep, with ramshackle buildings growing up around the walls.
A farming community and market town with a bridge approach.
Aldric styles himself a lord here, basing his authority on the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bMcEmJw3tHo7cvJN]{Greenholt name}.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} is widely recognized here but prefers to avoid attention since Aldric's power relies on Garland's absence.

Notable Features

  • Political center of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale}
  • Aldric's keep built on @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Imperium} ruins
  • Capital of a farming region with a market town
  • Bridge approach to the town
  • Lies directly in the path of the curse if the beaver dam on the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.ncbPkt06UQ9WQ2BL]{Ashen Flow} breaks; downstream of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.XkO2NGJCUTmTTq3F]{Beaver Lake}

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale} — The region Crownvale governs
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.ncbPkt06UQ9WQ2BL]{Ashen Flow} — The river whose cursed waters threaten the town
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.XkO2NGJCUTmTTq3F]{Beaver Lake} — Upstream; the spirit wall there is all that protects Crownvale

Associated NPCs

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric Garlandsson} — Ruler of Crownvale
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2H09dC5u3Cx4I9uf]{Mira} — Aldric's ten-year-old daughter
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.racfNNSIG5McsifR]{Sergeant Iyer} — Sergeant-at-arms in Aldric's guard

Events Here

  • Session 0 — Established as the seat of power in the Ashen Vale, at risk from the curse
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.QiQuaJOj62mEXbMZ]{Session 1} — The party stopped to resupply; Garland purchased horses while disguised; Edric distracted guards and gathered intelligence; Mira recognized Garland; the horse seller Laura accused Garland of theft; Roderic delivered a blessing urging compassion
